Priya Nair: Quick pulse  we've got BeaconCo on trial and their usage dropped 58% overnight. Trial ends in 7 days. Thinking of 'enable-first reactivation' play: targeted lab + small technical fix + 7-day credit.

Tom Blake: what technical fix?

Priya Nair: they hit rate-limit errors due to missing retry logic in their client example. We can send a patched client snippet and run a 20-min lab to walk through retries.

Revenue Ops: do we have budget for credits?

Priya Nair: recommending 1500 tokens + 7-day priority support. Low cost.

CS-automation-bot: Action created: send_patch_snippet -> assignee Tom Blake.

Tom Blake: will update the SDK snippet and add example retry backoff. Also add a small test harness they can run in 5 mins.

Priya Nair: cadence: immediate patch email, 48-hour lab offer, 5-day reminder, 2-day pre-expiry. If they run a job successfully, CSM does a 1:1.

Tom Blake: will also add event `retry_fix_applied` and `first_success_post_patch`.

Priya Nair: email draft: 
```
Hey {{first_name}},
We saw some rate-limit errors from your test client. We've attached a small patched snippet with retry/backoff and a one-click test harness. Want to run a quick 20-min lab to verify? Here's a slot: {{calendly}}
```

Revenue Ops: approved. we'll provision 1500 tokens on acceptance.

Priya Nair: great. I'll send now and follow up.

Tom Blake: update 1765201450  patch sent, lab link included. Will monitor events.
